name: arctic
description: A data-science DataFrame library for Bantu — the power of pandas + polars, made simple. DataFrame/Series with method chaining, a plain-English query() filter DSL, groupby/agg, joins, sort, describe; lazy frames with predicate + projection pushdown; datetime/date/categorical dtypes; CSV (sub-second on 1M rows), SQLite, and Parquet/Feather I/O (opt-in Arrow build); pretty-printing. Written in pure Bantu on the native columnar primitives (col_*); fast on millions of rows.
